accommodation.notes: Rent deducted for company housing: a site says 20,000 to 30,000 is usual (cost shared by residents, never above actual cost, no legal cap); high is the Tokyo student-housing average. Utilities (5,000 to 10,000) are extra and not counted.

source.publisher: Gaikoku Saiyo no Madoguchi (gaikokusaiyo.com), housing for technical interns, article of 11 September 2025

other_sources.publisher: Study in Japan (JASSO), accommodation: Tokyo average rent 57,000, 2023 survey

food.notes: A single person's monthly food: 20,000 cooking on a budget, 27,700 groceries on average, 45,000 mixing cooking and eating out (E-Housing, July 2025). Company cafeteria meals, if any, are deducted separately and not counted.

source.publisher: E-Housing, how much food costs in Japan, article of 28 July 2025

other_sources.publisher: Japan Living Life, monthly budget guide for foreign residents, updated 7 October 2026

transport.notes: Low: employers often pay the commuter pass (Tokyo metropolitan government FAQ). High: 12,000 in a moderate Tokyo budget (Japan Living Life). Typical is the midpoint, an assumption. Tokyo Metro IC fares could not be read.

source.publisher: Tokyo Metropolitan Government, Tokyo Career Guide, cost of living FAQ

other_sources.publisher: Japan Living Life, monthly budget guide for foreign residents, updated 7 October 2026

phone_data.notes: Tax-included monthly prices: IIJmio 5 GB 950 and 10 GB 1,400 (April 2025), ahamo 30 GB 2,970 with no admin fee. ahamo's price structure changes on 1 December 2026. Japan Living Life puts mobile plus internet at 8,000.

source.publisher: IIJmio, Giga plan price changes, article of 15 April 2025

mandatory_deductions.notes: Worker's half, FY2026: pension 9.15 (18.3 split), health 4.72 / 4.925 / 5.275 (Okinawa / Tokyo / Saga, half of 9.44 / 9.85 / 10.55), child-support levy 0.115, employment insurance 0.5. Income and resident tax not checked.

source.publisher: Japan Pension Service, employees' pension premium: 18.3%, half each

other_sources.publisher: Japan Health Insurance Association, FY2026 rates by prefecture
Japan Health Insurance Association, FY2026 premium notice (shared by employer and employee)
Children and Families Agency, child and child-rearing support levy (0.23%, half each)
Tachikawa Hello Work (MHLW), employment insurance rates FY2026: worker 5/1,000

sim_card.notes: ahamo charges no admin fee and no shipping for a new SIM; the first month's plan is counted in phone_data. IIJmio's initial fees were not read.

private_rental_move_in.notes: Only if the worker rents privately instead of living in the employer's housing: first-time renters should budget 400,000 to 800,000 for deposit, key money and agent fee; typical is the midpoint. Japan Living Life, not an official figure.

source.publisher: Japan Living Life, monthly budget guide for foreign residents, updated 7 October 2026
